name: Yomo Renji
source:
Yomo Renji is the right-hand man of Yoshimura. He is an old friend of [url=/c73123]Uta[/url] and [url=/c73568]Itori[/url]. Because of his scavenging habits and long-beaked, avian mask, he has the nickname of Raven (カラス, Karasu).

[From [url=http://tokyoghoul.wikia.com/wiki/Yomo]Tokyo Ghoul Wikia[/url]]
